tools.name: search_catalog
tools.description: Search TheBetterBuy product catalog. Returns a slimmed list of products (title, slug, brand, price, image, number of offers) plus a total count. Use list_categories to discover valid category values. Sorting is only supported by price.

tools.name: get_product
tools.description: Fetch a single full product by slug (preferred) or GTIN, including all retailer offers (sources). Provide exactly one of slug or gtin.

tools.name: get_offers
tools.description: Return the retailer offers (price, link, shipping/returns info) for a product identified by slug or GTIN, plus affiliate-link fallbacks. Provide exactly one of slug or gtin.

tools.name: list_categories
tools.description: List the available product categories with their filter tag, human-readable name, and product count. Use the returned 'category' value as the category filter in search_catalog.
